ops.title: Flaky under load: TestHolderRegistersExactAuthenticatedOwnerBeforeCatalogAndFencesSourceEpoch (WaitReady: runtime is not ready)
ops.description: holder/source_authority_reap_recovery_test.go:171 fails intermittently with `WaitReady: daemon: runtime is not ready`. Proven pre-existing and load-sensitive (2026-07-26, helper-plist fix wave): fails on unmodified origin/main in a clean worktree under -race -count=5 with the identical message; passes and fails intermittently on a feature branch (pass at 6.45s, fail at 3.43s — fast-fail signature) while the machine carried ~950 uid processes. The real-daemon readiness wait starves under load. Fix is a design call on the readiness timeout/backoff for real-spawn tests, not a blind timeout bump. Expect this flake in CI or local runs whenever the machine is loaded.

ops.text: Test passes -race -count=5 on a machine under heavy process load (~1000 uid procs)
